from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ProvidedPaperCitation(BaseModel):
    """A record of which provided papers one paper cites."""
    paper_title: str = Field(description="This paper's title, as it appears in the collection")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list (matching from the known collection)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[ProvidedPaperCitation]
